_about: Meta Quest games kept from the 2026-11-20 Meta data export (Ronjan's picks 2026-11-20): only Quest-era titles with a cloud save, minus YouTube, MLK: Now is the Time and Xtadium (not games). Gear VR era (2015-2019) left out entirely. A play day is the first cloud-save day, plus (Beat Saber only) the first visit to each level, which the export ties to Beat Saber's app id. Achievement days are not used: the export has no game or achievement names. No hours: the export has no play time.
